title: Commutes Sentence of Kwame Kilpatrick
description_short: Trump commuted the sentence of former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick, convicted of corruption.
description_medium: President Donald Trump commuted the sentence of former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick, who had been convicted of public corruption. A commutation changes the punishment imposed while leaving the conviction in place. The action affected Kilpatrick’s sentence rather than clearing the underlying criminal judgment or erasing the public corruption conviction.
